facts.claim: Pi 'does not ask for approval before every tool call'; default enabled tools read, bash, edit, write.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: --tools / --no-tools / --exclude-tools restrict declared tools; no allow/deny command rules.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D01.rationale: By design there is no permission/approval system: bash/edit/write run unprompted; only tool selection flags exist.

facts.claim: Docs: safety comes from limiting what Pi can access; watching transcripts or project trust is not a security boundary; see containerization.md.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D02.rationale: No built-in sandbox; docs direct users to containers/VMs.

facts.claim: PI_OFFLINE disables automatic network activity (model catalog refresh, version check) only.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D03.rationale: No egress control in Pi; PI_OFFLINE only affects Pi's own requests.

facts.claim: Protected resources: .pi/settings.json, .pi/mcp.json, .pi/extensions|skills|prompts|themes, .pi/SYSTEM.md|APPEND_SYSTEM.md, .agents/skills; defaultProjectTrust default is 'ask'.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md context files load regardless of project trust.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: CVE-2026-54325 'Pi loads project-local extensions without approval' fixed in 0.79.0.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D04.rationale: Explicit project-trust gate (ask by default) covering settings, MCP, extensions, skills, prompts, system-prompt files; saved decisions; extension-handled; non-interactive modes skip unless configured; caveats: sessionDir pre-read, context files not gated.

facts.claim: Project servers from .pi/mcp.json are read only after project trust; project entry replaces same-named user entry; enabled/exposure/toolExposure controls.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D05.rationale: Project MCP servers need project trust; user MCP is explicit; per-server enabled/exposure controls; no central allowlist or tool-change detection documented.

facts.claim: Packages install from npm/git/local; versioned npm specs and git tags/commits are pinned; project packages load only after trust; 'Extensions execute inside the Pi process'.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: CVE-2026-54328 (high): predictable temporary extension install paths allow local privilege escalation on shared Linux hosts; fixed 0.78.1.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D06.rationale: Extensions/packages (npm, git) run in-process with full privileges; versions pinnable; project packages gated by trust; no signing or vetting.

facts.claim: auth.json written with mode 0o600 in 0o700 dir (source: auth-storage.ts).
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: CVE-2026-54327: race condition in auth.json writes could expose stored credentials; fixed 0.78.1.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Docs warn sessions can contain prompts, tool arguments, command output, file contents and credentials.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D07.rationale: Plaintext auth.json (0600/0700) with a prior write-race CVE; no keychain; models.json can run `!command` for keys; no documented transcript redaction.

facts.claim: Print, JSON and RPC modes cannot show the trust prompt; 'ask'/'never' skip protected project resources, 'always' loads them.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D08.rationale: Print/JSON/RPC modes run with the same unprompted tools; project resources skipped unless defaultProjectTrust=always; --approve/--no-approve explicit; no official CI action.

facts.claim: No memory feature in docs index; AGENTS.md is user-authored context.
facts.label: unverified

facts.claim: Minimal harness; no subagent docs in docs directory listing.
facts.label: unverified

facts.claim: Sessions are saved automatically unless --no-session; stored under ~/.pi/agent/sessions/ grouped by cwd.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: CVE-2026-54326: XSS in HTML session exports via Markdown URL sanitization bypass; fixed 0.78.1.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D11.rationale: Sessions saved by default as JSONL under ~/.pi/agent/sessions; export/share features; no structured audit log or OTel.

facts.claim: enableInstallTelemetry default true: anonymous install/update reporting and provider attribution headers; PI_TELEMETRY / PI_SKIP_VERSION_CHECK / PI_OFFLINE.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D12.rationale: Only anonymous install/update telemetry + version check, both documented with env opt-outs; prompts go only to the configured provider.

facts.claim: curl installer pins all dependencies; npm route uses --ignore-scripts and does not need lifecycle scripts.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: No signature/checksum/provenance statement found for pi.dev/install.sh.
facts.label: unverified

D13.rationale: Installer pins dependencies; npm install documented with --ignore-scripts; Nix build from source; no signing/provenance information found.

facts.claim: Config layers: user agent dir and project .pi only.
facts.label: unverified

D14.rationale: No managed/enterprise policy layer found in configuration docs.

facts.claim: SECURITY.md: report to security@earendil.com or GitHub Security Advisories.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: 4 published GHSAs / CVEs (CVE-2026-54325..54328) on 2026-06-08.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D15.rationale: SECURITY.md with private email + GHSA channel; four advisories with CVE IDs issued (June 2026) and fixes shipped; clear boundary statement.
